:::{#thm-bernoulli-score}
#### Score function of a Bernoulli variable

Let $X \sim \Ber(\prob)$, with event probability $\prob$ and observed value $x \in \cb{0, 1}$.
The [score](#def-score) $\score$ of the single observation $x$
is the derivative of its log-likelihood $\loglik$ with respect to $\prob$.
It equals the [precision](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-precision) $\precision = 1 / \Var{X}$ of $X$
times the [deviation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean) $\devn \eqdef x - \E{X}$ of $x$ from the mean $\E{X}$:

$$\score = \precision \devn = \frac{\devn}{\Var{X}} = \frac{x - \prob}{\prob(1 - \prob)}$$

:::

::: proof

The score as $\precision (x - \prob)$ is the solution to @exr-derive-bernoulli-score, worked in @sol-derive-bernoulli-score.
Writing it as $\precision \devn$ is the solution to @exr-derive-bernoulli-score-deviation,
worked in @sol-derive-bernoulli-score-deviation.
The remaining equalities restate $\precision = 1 / \Var{X}$ and $\Var{X} = \prob(1 - \prob)$.
The proof builds on @cor-bernoulli-loglik-contribution-logodds.

:::
